key_insight: PDI-Bench introduces a simple, quantitative metric—the Perspective Distortion Index—that detects and diagnoses geometric inconsistency in generated videos by measuring perspective distortions across frames, converting subjective judgments into actionable scores.
problem_solved: Evaluating whether generative video models produce physically plausible 3D structure and motion is hard: existing pipelines rely on human raters or learned graders that are subjective and weak at pinpointing geometric failures. PDI-Bench provides an objective, diagnostic audit for geometric coherence.
method: Estimate frame-to-frame camera motion and scene geometry cues (depth proxies or optical flow) from a generated clip to recover expected perspective transformations.
Compute pixel- and region-level deviations between observed image correspondences and the geometry-predicted projections to derive a Perspective Distortion Index and diagnostic heatmaps.

Aggregate per-frame and per-clip statistics to produce interpretable scores and visual diagnostics for benchmarking models and isolating common failure modes (e.g., inconsistent parallax, drifting vanishing points).
impact: Gives practitioners an objective, interpretable tool to benchmark and debug generative video/world models for 3D consistency—accelerating improvements in modeling, safer deployment in robotics/AR, and more reliable synthetic data.
visual_elements: Side-by-side video frames: real vs. generated with overlaid PDI heatmaps highlighting geometric errors.
Pipeline diagram: clip input → camera/flow estimation → perspective consistency check → PDI score + diagnostic maps.
Bar/box plot: PDI scores comparing multiple generative models or ablations to show relative geometric fidelity.
Illustration of perspective geometry: vanishing-point/grid deformation examples showing typical failure modes (parallax errors, depth slip).
paper_title: Quantitative Video World Model Evaluation for Geometric-Consistency
paper_authors: Jiaxin Wu, Yihao Pi, Yinling Zhang, Yuheng Li, Xueyan Zou
